name: Input capture
threading: One control thread (arm/stop/cancel/take) plus one audio thread (process); they communicate only through atomics. process() allocates, locks and waits for nothing.
standalone_test_command: cmake -S modules/input_capture -B build/input_capture && cmake --build build/input_capture && ctest --test-dir build/input_capture
summary: Real-time-safe recorder for a plugin's audio input. Arm, record freely or exactly N bars starting on a bar line, stop, then take the audio as a planar buffer. Sample-accurate and independent of the host block size.
public_api: `Capture::process(in, channels, frames, Transport)` (audio thread, no allocation)
limits: At most 60 seconds and 100 MB; mono or stereo; sample rate 8 kHz to 384 kHz
A stop or cancel of a Recording capture takes effect on the next process() call
adapters: Your app calls process() from its audio callback with the host's transport and keeps the audio with take().
adapter_notes: The module never talks to a host, a file or a thread API. Captured audio is plain planar floats.
removal: Delete the folder; callers lose input capture only.
